modmenu.descriptionTranslation.sabercraf: Star Wars for Minecraft: cinematic lightsabers, blasters that use arrows as ammunition, droid companions, a flyable X-Wing, characters, planets and achievements.
sabercraft.customize.title: Customize saber
sabercraft.customize.unsupported: On this server only possible in creative mode, because SaberCraft is not installed there.
sabercraft.customize.no_saber: Hold a sword. A normal sword becomes a lightsaber here with one button (or with /sabercraft convert).
sabercraft.hilt.standard.description: The plain, flat hilt of the first version.
sabercraft.hilt.guardian.description: Classic silver hilt with black grip ridges and a clamp, in the style of an order knight.
sabercraft.hilt.dark_lord.description: Black hilt with silver ribs, red buttons and a toothed emitter. Ignites heavier and hums deeper.
sabercraft.hilt.sentinel.description: Black and silver hilt with a wrapped grip and a vented emitter.
sabercraft.hilt.double.description: Experimental: long hilt with a blade at each end. Both blades ignite together.
sabercraft.style.flowing.description: Quick, flowing cuts in a combo of diagonal, backhand, rising and overhead strikes. A stab while sprinting. Dodges with rolls.
sabercraft.style.heavy.description: Slow, powerful blows from a high stance. A strong thrust while sprinting. Dodges with side steps, forward with a deep lunge.
sabercraft.style.staff.description: Wide sweeps with both blades and turns around the body. The special key starts the blade whirl in front of the body.
sabercraft.ability.no_saber: Ignite a saber in your main hand first.
sabercraft.ability.no_server: Abilities need SaberCraft on the server.
sabercraft.style.defensive.description: Low, wide stance with short, economical cuts close to the body. Longer parry window, blocks hold more and cost less stamina. Slower dodges.
sabercraft.style.agile.description: Blade held high, fast springy cuts with turns, hops and a flip. Quick, cheap dodges, but weaker blocks.
sabercraft.menu.combat.title: Combat, powers and keys
sabercraft.menu.combat.note: What a power does, its cooldown and its stamina cost are decided by the server (config/sabercraft/abilities.json). Here you set what only affects your game.
sabercraft.menu.space.title: Sky and planets
sabercraft.menu.space.note: Stars, nebulae, galaxies, planets and moons instead of the plain night sky, different in every dimension. Only in your game; off = the normal Minecraft sky. With an Iris shader pack it stays off unless you allow it.
sabercraft.menu.music.title: Music
sabercraft.menu.music.note: Original pieces for exploring, night, combat and special moments, with smooth transitions. Replaces the normal game music while it is on. Your own .ogg files go into config/sabercraft/music/<mood>/; only use music you are allowed to use.
sabercraft.menu.graphics.title: Graphics and effects
sabercraft.menu.graphics.note: Fewer particles and a lower sky quality help on slower computers. "Blade with shaders" only matters while an Iris shader pack is active.
sabercraft.menu.character.title: Character
sabercraft.menu.character.take_saber.des: Gives the saber in your hand the hilt, color and fighting style that go with this outfit.
sabercraft.menu.character.saber_taken: The saber in your hand now matches the outfit.
sabercraft.option.combat_animations.desc: Own attack, defense and dodge animations instead of the normal swing.
sabercraft.option.ready_stance.descripti: Resting and defensive poses while a lit saber is held.
sabercraft.option.ability_hud.descriptio: Cooldowns and stamina next to the hotbar.
sabercraft.option.space_sky.description: Stars, nebulae, galaxies, planets and moons instead of the plain night sky, different in every dimension. Only in your game; off = the normal Minecraft sky. With an Iris shader pack it stays off unless you allow it.
sabercraft.option.space_sky_quality.desc: Resolution of the sky: low 256, medium 512, high 1024, ultra 1536 pixels per side. Painted in the background. Ultra needs about 170 MB of video memory with a planet and the space sky together.
sabercraft.option.shader_blade.descripti: With an Iris shader pack the blade is drawn as a self-lit beam that the pack knows and lets glow. Off: the old look, which many packs show almost transparent. Fewer particles and a lower sky quality help on slower computers.
sabercraft.option.space_sky_in_end.descr: A space sky of its own in the End too, over the normal End sky.
sabercraft.option.space_sky_with_shaders: Show the sky even while an Iris shader pack is active. Shader packs usually draw their own sky.
sabercraft.option.music.description: Own music for the situation instead of the normal game music. Off = normal Minecraft music.
sabercraft.option.music_volume.descripti: Own volume of the SaberCraft music, on top of Minecraft's music slider.
sabercraft.option.music_crossfade.descri: How long one piece fades out and the next fades in.
sabercraft.option.music_user_files.descr: Also play your own .ogg files from config/sabercraft/music/.
sabercraft.option.blade_trails.descripti: A glowing trail behind the blade during fast movements.
sabercraft.option.trail_strength.descrip: How bright the light trail glows.
sabercraft.option.particles.description: Amount of sparks and power effects.
sabercraft.option.hide_vanilla_sweep.des: Hides Minecraft's white sweep arc next to sabers.
sabercraft.option.camera_motion.descript: How much the camera follows rolls and landings.
sabercraft.option.show_other_outfits.des: Show the outfits other players chose. Off: everyone else looks like their normal skin.
sabercraft.option.music_stingers.descrip: A short piece once after a won fight and when you fall. In the Star Wars mode only if there are files in victory/ or defeat/.
sabercraft.option.planet_ambient.descrip: The sound of the chosen planet while you are in the Overworld: desert wind on Tatooine, the blizzard on Hoth, lava on Mustafar, the forest of Endor, the lake of Naboo, the city of Coruscant. Quieter under a roof. Only for you; the world does not change.
Volume of the planet sounds, on top of the Ambient/Environment slider in the sound settings.
sabercraft.outfit.none.description: Your normal Minecraft skin with all its layers, as set in the skin customization.
sabercraft.outfit.wanderer.description: Light tunic, open brown robe, hood down. Calm and balanced.
sabercraft.outfit.shadow.description: Black robe with a crimson sash, the hood deep over the face.
sabercraft.outfit.sentinel.description: Silver plates over a dark green suit, shoulder pads and greaves.
sabercraft.outfit.scout.description: Light leather vest, yellow scarf, gloves and high boots. Made for agility.
sabercraft.outfit.twilight.description: Dark plate armor with violet light lines and a closed helmet.
sabercraft.outfit.file.description: Your own skins: 64 x 64 PNG in the skin layout in config/sabercraft/outfits/. They replace your skin completely. Only you see them, they are never sent.
sabercraft.profile.description: Characters of your own without changing the mod: a JSON file per character in config/sabercraft/profiles/ with name, skin (or base character), hilt, color, style and side. The skin stays on this computer; others see the base character or your plain skin. See docs/custom-profiles.md.
sabercraft.profile.no_saber: This profile has no saber of its own; it only changes your look.
sabercraft.hilt.kenobi.description: Silver hilt with black grip rings and a flared, vented emitter. After the saber of a calm master.
sabercraft.hilt.skywalker.description: Black grip, silver body and a long emitter cone with a small control box. After a young knight's self-built saber.
sabercraft.style.djem_so.description: Darth Vader's style: the blade upright in both hands, slow crushing blows from high above that throw the target back. A firm guard, but slow, costly dodges.
sabercraft.style.soresu.description: Obi-Wan Kenobi's style: the blade high over the head, the free hand stretched out. Short controlled cuts and quick ripostes. The longest parry window and the strongest, cheapest blocks.
sabercraft.style.juyo.description: Darth Maul's style with the double blade: the staff carried low, fast sweeps that turn into full spins, a blade whirl. Quick spin steps and back flips, a weaker guard.
sabercraft.character.vader.description: Black armor with helmet, chest panel and cape. Red saber, Djem So style, a deep heavy sound.
sabercraft.character.obi_wan.description: Jedi tunic, brown robe, auburn hair and beard. Blue saber with the Kenobi hilt, Soresu style.
sabercraft.character.maul.description: Black robes, a red and black face, yellow eyes and small horns. Red double blade, Juyo style with fast spins.
sabercraft.character.luke.description: Black Jedi clothes with one black glove, sandy hair. Green saber with the Skywalker hilt, flowing style.
sabercraft.menu.character.characters.des: Famous Star Wars characters. Picking one gives you their look and gives the saber in your hand their hilt, color and fighting style. You can still change everything in the saber menu afterwards.
sabercraft.menu.character.outfits.descri: Original robes and armor as complete skins with their own face. They replace your skin completely; nothing of it stays visible.
sabercraft.menu.character.folder.charact: Your own character skins: 64 x 64 PNG in the skin layout, named after the character (vader.png, obi_wan.png, maul.png, luke.png, anakin.png, yoda.png, dooku.png, ahsoka.png, kylo.png, rey.png, ezra.png) in config/sabercraft/characters/. Replaces the built-in look on this computer.
sabercraft.option.planet.description: Turns the Overworld sky into a Star Wars planet: sky and fog colors, haze, moons, suns and particles. Terrain and world generation stay the same. "Off" = normal sky.
sabercraft.option.planet_particles.descr: Snowflakes on Hoth and falling ash on Mustafar, only under the open sky.
sabercraft.option.planet_horizon.descrip: A far landscape on the horizon (dunes, giant trees, ice mountains, volcanoes with lava and smoke, hills) and details in the sky: air traffic over Coruscant, an aurora over Hoth, clouds over Naboo. Only painted into the sky; the terrain is not changed.
sabercraft.option.planet_shader_tint.des: Only with an Iris shader pack: lays a semi-transparent layer in the planet's sky color over the sky, because shader packs compute the sky color themselves.
sabercraft.option.planet_celestials.desc: Each planet has its own sun and moon: Tatooine's big white sun and a smaller orange one, Mustafar's dim red disc behind the smoke, a small cold sun and a large icy moon over Hoth, a big pale moon over Naboo. Only size and color change.
sabercraft.option.planet_transition.desc: How long a newly chosen planet takes to fade in over the old sky (colors, sky layer, sun and moon). 0 switches at once.
sabercraft.planet.none.description: No planet: the normal Minecraft sky (with the space sky at night, if it is on).
sabercraft.planet.tatooine.description: Desert planet: a pale, hot sky, dunes and far mesas on the horizon, two suns, warm evenings and two moons.
sabercraft.planet.coruscant.description: City planet: a hazy sky over an endless skyline with air traffic that lights up in a thousand windows and lights at night.
sabercraft.planet.endor.description: Forest moon: a soft green-blue sky, a wall of giant trees in the mist and the big ringed gas giant above.
sabercraft.planet.hoth.description: Ice planet: cold, pale light, snowy ice mountains on the horizon, two moons, snow in the air and an aurora in the north at night.
sabercraft.planet.mustafar.description: Volcanic planet: a dark red, smoky sky, volcanoes with lava streams and smoke plumes, a lava glow over the horizon and falling ash.
sabercraft.planet.naboo.description: Green lake planet: a clear, deep blue sky with white clouds, soft hills, a big pale moon and a distant second one.
sabercraft.option.music_mode.description: SaberCraft: the mod's built-in music (as before). Star Wars: plays your own music files from config/sabercraft/starwars_music/ to fit the situation. Both modes have separate settings.
sabercraft.option.starwars_volume.descri: Own volume of the Star Wars mode, on top of the master and music sliders.
sabercraft.option.starwars_crossfade.des: On: tracks blend smoothly (length as set in the SaberCraft mode). Off: a short cut.
sabercraft.option.starwars_combat.descri: Music in lightsaber duels, dramatic encounters and boss fights.
sabercraft.option.starwars_exploration.d: Music while exploring by day and in calm moments at night and underground.
sabercraft.option.starwars_character_the: Plays a character's theme when you pick them or another player as that character comes near (e.g. characters/vader.ogg).
sabercraft.menu.music.starwars.reload.de: Reads the folder and mapping.json again after you added files.
sabercraft.menu.music.starwars.empty: No music files found: put .ogg or .wav files into config/sabercraft/starwars_music/ (see README.txt).
sabercraft.menu.music.starwars.context.n: Planets and characters: no files of their own (planets/, characters/<name>/)
sabercraft.menu.music.starwars.note: No film music included. Formats: .ogg and .wav (convert MP3 to .ogg). Folders or mapping.json, see README.txt.
sabercraft.hilt.anakin.description: Black ribbed grip between silver rings, a small gold switch and an angled, clawed emitter. After a bold young knight's saber.
sabercraft.hilt.yoda.description: A short, stout hilt for a small hand with a shorter blade. After an old master's saber.
sabercraft.hilt.dooku.description: Elegant curved hilt for one-handed fencing: dark leather, silver and gold. After a count's saber.
sabercraft.hilt.tano.description: Slim white and silver hilt with black grip rings, made for the reverse grip.
sabercraft.hilt.crossguard.description: Battered dark hilt with a crossguard: two short side blades and a crackling, unstable main blade.
sabercraft.hilt.rey.description: Short bronze hilt with a leather wrap, built from a piece of a scavenger's staff.
sabercraft.hilt.ezra.description: Grey hilt with orange bands and a folding grip: a stun blaster is built in. Right-click fires it, even with the blade lit.
sabercraft.style.onslaught.description: Anakin Skywalker's aggressive Form V: a high guard over the shoulder, relentless power blows, a double strike and a leaping attack. Throws targets back, rolls aside quickly, but a weaker guard.
sabercraft.style.ataru.description: Yoda's acrobatic style: low and coiled, somersaults over the target, spinning cuts, a long rolling leap and a whirlwind in the air. The fastest dodges, but a weak guard.
sabercraft.style.makashi.description: Count Dooku's fencing: upright, one-handed, the free hand behind the back. Thrusts, wrist flicks, a disengage and a long flying lunge. A long parry window and cheap blocks.
sabercraft.style.reverse_shien.descripti: Ahsoka Tano's reverse-grip Shien: the blade points back along the forearm. Hooking slashes, a stab behind, rising cuts, low dash cuts and spins. Quick rolls and back flips.
sabercraft.style.unbridled.description: Kylo Ren's raw, wild style: hunched, the blade held low. Huge hammer blows from behind the head, wild wide swings and a frenzy of three strikes. The furthest knockback, but a poor guard.
sabercraft.style.shii_cho.description: Rey's staff-trained Form I: a two-handed middle guard, wide sweeps from side to side with the whole body, a staff twirl in front and a rising charge. A solid all-round guard.
sabercraft.style.improvised.description: Ezra Bridger's street fighting: quick one-handed cuts with a hop, a low slide under the guard, a cartwheel over the top, rolls and back flips. The guard is weak, the dodges are quick and cheap.
sabercraft.character.anakin.description: Dark Jedi tunic with black leather tabards and a dark robe, brown hair, a scar over one eye, one black glove. Blue saber with the Anakin hilt, Onslaught style.
sabercraft.character.yoda.description: Green skin, wide ears, a few white hairs, a beige tunic and a coarse brown robe. Drawn small. Short green blade, Ataru style with flips and spins.
sabercraft.character.dooku.description: White hair and beard, a dark suit, a long cape with a silver clasp chain. Red saber with the curved Count hilt, Makashi fencing.
sabercraft.character.ahsoka.description: Orange skin with white markings, blue and white striped montrals and head-tails, a dark top with arm wraps. White saber held in the reverse grip.
sabercraft.character.ezra.description: Star Wars Rebels, seasons 1 and 2: orange jumpsuit, dark blue hair, energy slingshot on the left wrist. Blue saber on his hilt with the built-in stun blaster, improvised style.
sabercraft.character.kylo.description: Black helmet with a silver trim, black hooded robes and a quilted tunic. Unstable red crossguard saber, Unbridled style.
sabercraft.character.rey.description: Light wrapped desert clothes, grey arm wraps, a brown belt, hair in three buns. Yellow saber on her staff-piece hilt, Shii-Cho style.
sabercraft.option.character_size.descrip: Draws small characters like Yoda at their size. Only the picture is smaller: the hitbox, the camera and the name tag stay as they are. Off: normal player size.
death.attack.sabercraft.blaster: %1$s was hit by a blaster bolt
sabercraft.command.converted: %s is now a lightsaber. Change hilt, color and style in the SaberCraft menu (%s).
sabercraft.command.changed: The lightsaber got a new hilt or color.
sabercraft.command.already_saber: This already is a lightsaber. Give a color (and hilt) to change it, or use /sabercraft revert.
sabercraft.command.not_a_sword: Hold a sword in your main hand: wooden, stone, copper, iron, golden, diamond or netherite.
sabercraft.command.not_possible: That does not work with this item.
sabercraft.command.reverted_bow: The blaster is a normal bow again.
sabercraft.command.not_converted: This item is not a lightsaber or blaster.
sabercraft.command.nothing_to_revert: Hold a lightsaber or blaster in your main hand.
sabercraft.command.blaster: The bow is now a blaster: %s. Right-click fires.
sabercraft.command.already_blaster: This already is a blaster. Give a type to change it, or use /sabercraft blaster revert.
sabercraft.command.not_a_bow: Hold a bow in your main hand.
sabercraft.duel.button.accept.hover: Accept the duel: best of three, starts after a countdown.
sabercraft.duel.challenged: %s challenges you to a lightsaber duel (best of three). It is up to you:
sabercraft.duel.too_far: The duel ends: you are too far apart.
sabercraft.duel.died: %s fell to something else; the duel ends.
sabercraft.duel.started: The duel begins: best of three. /sabercraft duel leave gives up.
sabercraft.duel.sent: Challenge sent to %s. They have a minute to accept.
sabercraft.duel.disabled: Duels are switched off on this server.
sabercraft.duel.busy: You are already in a duel.
sabercraft.duel.no_challenge: There is no open challenge for you.
sabercraft.duel.not_in_duel: You are not in a duel.
sabercraft.duel.ignore_on: You no longer get challenges. The same command turns them on again.
sabercraft.blaster.dl44.description: Heavy pistol of a smuggler: hard-hitting, slow to recover. Few shots, but each one counts.
sabercraft.blaster.e11.description: Standard rifle of the Imperial stormtroopers: quick shots, not very precise.
sabercraft.blaster.dc15a.description: Long rifle of the clone troopers: blue bolts, very long range and precise.
sabercraft.blaster.se14c.description: Small sidearm of the Imperial officers: very fast, weak bolts, short range.
sabercraft.blaster.bowcaster.description: Crossbow of the Wookiees: slow, green bolts that hit hard and push the target back.
sabercraft.blaster.a280.description: Rifle of the Rebel Alliance: precise and fast bolts over a long range.
sabercraft.blaster.repeater.description: Heavy repeating blaster: two bolts per shot (one arrow), heats up fast and slows you down.
sabercraft.blaster.rebel.description: Light blaster of the Rebel fleet troopers: blue bolts, reliable all-rounder.
sabercraft.blaster.ezra.description: Ezra Bridger's energy weapon: yellow stun bolts that freeze the target for two seconds.
sabercraft.blaster.menu.title: Blasters
sabercraft.blaster.menu.unsupported: This server has no SaberCraft: blasters are not available.
sabercraft.blaster.menu.no_bow: Hold a bow or blaster in your main hand to convert it.
sabercraft.blaster.menu.not_allowed: Only operators may convert items on this server.
sabercraft.blaster.no_ammo: No arrows – a blaster needs one arrow per shot.
advancements.sabercraft.root.title: SaberCraft
advancements.sabercraft.root.description: Your own galaxy awaits: sabers, blasters, droids and starships
advancements.sabercraft.force_awakens.de: Hold a lightsaber in your hand
advancements.sabercraft.first_shot.title: The First Shot
advancements.sabercraft.sharpshooter.des: Hit a target with a blaster bolt from at least 30 blocks away
advancements.sabercraft.duel_begins.desc: Start a lightsaber duel with another player
advancements.sabercraft.dark_lord.title: The Dark Lord
advancements.sabercraft.dark_lord.descri: Win a duel as a character of the dark side
advancements.sabercraft.chosen_one.title: The Chosen One
advancements.sabercraft.chosen_one.descr: Use every saber ability: guard, spin, push, dodge, grip, pull and Force jump
advancements.sabercraft.spin_speed.title: Rotational Speed
advancements.sabercraft.spin_speed.descr: Hit two enemies with a single spin attack
advancements.sabercraft.finisher.title: A Worthy Ending
advancements.sabercraft.finisher.descrip: Defeat an opponent with a lightsaber finishing blow
sabercraft.option.hit_marks.description: A small glowing spot in the blade color stays for a few seconds where a lightsaber struck. Only a glow: nothing is cut, the skin stays as it is.
sabercraft.option.finisher_effects.descr: The blow that defeats an opponent sends out a ring of light and briefly flashes the screen in the blade color.
sabercraft.droid.menu.title: Droids
sabercraft.droid.menu.unsupported: This server has no SaberCraft droids.
sabercraft.droid.menu.full: You already have %s droids out. Send one home first.
sabercraft.droid.menu.hint: Right-click a droid to talk, sneak + right-click: stay or follow.
sabercraft.droid.r2d2.description: A loyal astromech. Brave, stubborn and always beeping something.
sabercraft.droid.r2d2.ability: Repair: removes a quarter of the wear from the item in your hand.
sabercraft.droid.c3po.description: A protocol droid in gold plating. Polite, nervous and well informed.
sabercraft.droid.c3po.ability: Report: counts hostile creatures nearby and tells you the time and weather.
sabercraft.droid.bb8.description: A rolling astromech with a head that always stays on top.
sabercraft.droid.bb8.ability: Scan: hostile creatures within 24 blocks glow for ten seconds.
sabercraft.droid.chopper.description: A grumpy old astromech with a short temper and an electric arm.
sabercraft.droid.chopper.ability: Zap: an electric shock to every hostile creature right next to it.
sabercraft.droid.mouse.description: A small, busy mouse droid that scurries along the floor.
sabercraft.droid.mouse.ability: Fetch: brings dropped items within 12 blocks to you.
sabercraft.droid.probe.description: A floating probe droid with long sensor arms.
sabercraft.droid.probe.ability: Survey: finds the most valuable ore within 16 blocks and tells you where it is.
sabercraft.droid.b1.description: A thin battle droid. Not very bright, but quick on the trigger.
sabercraft.droid.b1.ability: Burst: fires three blaster bolts at the nearest hostile creature in sight.
sabercraft.droid.k2so.description: A tall security droid, blunt and honest to a fault.
sabercraft.droid.k2so.ability: Shove: pushes hostile creatures close to you away.
sabercraft.droid.disabled: Droids are turned off on this server.
sabercraft.droid.limit: You can only have %s droids out at once. Send one home first.
sabercraft.droid.no_room: There is no room here for %s.
sabercraft.droid.r2d2.nothing: R2-D2 beeps: nothing in your hand needs repairing.
sabercraft.droid.c3po.safe: C-3PO: "No hostile creatures within %s blocks. It is %s, and the weather is %s. How reassuring."
sabercraft.droid.c3po.danger: C-3PO: "Hostile creatures nearby: %s! It is %s, and the weather is %s. Do be careful."
sabercraft.droid.c3po.time.none: impossible to say what time it is here
sabercraft.droid.mouse.nothing: The mouse droid finds nothing to fetch.
sabercraft.droid.probe.nothing: Probe droid: no ore within %s blocks.
sabercraft.droid.k2so.nothing: K-2SO: "There is nobody here worth shoving."
Use the ability of every droid once
ship.sabercraft.xwing.description: A one-seat starfighter with four S-foils and four laser cannons. Quick, agile and tough enough for a crash landing.
ship.sabercraft.tie_fighter.description: The Empire's agile fighter: two laser cannons firing green twin bolts, turns faster than the X-Wing, but a thinner hull and no folding wings.
ship.sabercraft.tie_interceptor.descript: The fastest TIE, with dagger wings and four laser cannons at the wing tips. Very agile and very fast, but the weakest hull.
ship.sabercraft.falcon.description: A fast freighter: two laser turrets, the radar dish turns, landing legs come out near the ground. Fast but heavy, turns slower than the fighters and lasts longest in the air.
ship.sabercraft.star_destroyer.descripti: A huge capital ship: six turbolaser batteries, cruises slowly at a fixed height above the ground and never pitches. No landing; climb out wherever it hovers.
sabercraft.ship.menu.title: Hangar
sabercraft.ship.menu.call.tooltip: Lands the ship a few blocks in front of you
sabercraft.ship.menu.fly.tooltip: Calls the ship if needed and puts you in the cockpit
sabercraft.ship.menu.unsupported: This server has no SaberCraft, so there are no starships here.
sabercraft.ship.menu.hint: Right-click your ship to climb in, sneak to climb out. Only you can fly it.
sabercraft.ship.disabled: Starships are turned off on this server.
sabercraft.ship.planned: %s is still being built. It comes in a later version.
sabercraft.ship.no_room: There is no room here for %s.
sabercraft.ship.called: %s is ready. Right-click it to climb in.
sabercraft.ship.controls: W/S: throttle, A/D: turn, Space/Sprint: nose up/down, Attack: lasers, Sneak: climb out
sabercraft.ship.hud.keys: W/S throttle · A/D turn · Space/Sprint nose · Attack fire · Sneak exit
advancements.sabercraft.first_flight.des: Fly an X-Wing at full speed
sabercraft.option.blaster_draw.descripti: Taking a blaster into your hand swings it up into aim with a click; putting it away holsters it with its own sound.
sabercraft.option.menu_transitions.descr: Each page of this menu fades in with a short scan line and a soft sweep.
sabercraft.option.ship_third_person.desc: Climbing into a starship switches to the view behind the ship; climbing out brings back your view.
sabercraft.option.ship_hud.description: Speed, height, lasers and keys while flying a starship.
sabercraft.menu.sound.title: Sound
sabercraft.menu.sound.note: Every slider works on top of Minecraft's volume sliders and right away, even on a saber that is humming now. Music and planet sounds keep their sliders under "Music" and "Sky".
sabercraft.option.saber_volume.descripti: Volume of all lightsaber sounds: ignition, hum, swings, hits, blocks and Force powers. 0 % mutes them.
sabercraft.option.saber_hum_volume.descr: The steady hum of a lit blade, on top of the "Lightsabers" slider.
sabercraft.option.saber_hum_idle_quiet.d: Hold the blade still for a few seconds and it hums at half volume. Any movement brings the full hum back.
sabercraft.option.droid_volume.descripti: Volume of the droids: voices, steps and abilities.
sabercraft.option.droid_chatter.descript: Droids beep and murmur now and then on their own. Off: you only hear them when they do something.
sabercraft.option.ship_volume.descriptio: Volume of the starships: engines, lasers, crashes and wings.
sabercraft.menu.convert.title: Choose lightsaber
sabercraft.menu.convert.note: Only chosen swords are lightsabers. Every other sword stays a normal Minecraft sword, without blade, glow or lightsaber animations. A chosen sword stays the same item with its material, durability and enchantments; set hilt, color and fighting style afterwards.
sabercraft.customize.revert.description: Turns the lightsaber back into the normal sword it was before.
sabercraft.saber.convert.no_permission: Only operators can choose lightsabers on this server.
sabercraft.saber.convert.already: This sword already is a lightsaber.
sabercraft.saber.convert.not_allowed: This kind of sword cannot become a lightsaber on this server.
sabercraft.droid.key.look: Look at one of your droids to give it an order.
sabercraft.option.droid_target_hud.descr: While you look at one of your droids, its name, its ability and the keys show under the crosshair.
sabercraft.ship.destroyed: %s was destroyed. A new one is ready in %s seconds.
sabercraft.ship.grounded: Your last ship was destroyed. A new one is ready in %s seconds.
sabercraft.droid.combat_cooldown: Your combat droids need %s more seconds.
sabercraft.option.character_hide_armor.d: Players with a character skin show the skin instead of their armor pieces (elytras stay visible). Only the look: the armor still protects. Off: armor is drawn over the skin as usual.
sabercraft.option.ship_hide_pilot.descri: The player flying a ship is not drawn (no head sticking out of the cockpit, no hands in first person). They show again right after climbing out.
sabercraft.option.move_variety.descripti: Crits, sprint and normal swings pick from several moves of the character's style, never the same move twice in a row. Off: the fixed order of Phase 12.
sabercraft.option.signature_moves.descri: How often a character's signature move (like Ezra's 180° turn) plays on a crit, as a multiplier of the style's own chance. 0 = never, 1 = normal (rare), 3 = often. It never plays twice in a row.
sabercraft.ship.energy_empty: Energy empty! The engines cut out. Land and let them charge.
sabercraft.hyperspace.blocked: The way ahead is blocked. Turn to open space.
sabercraft.hyperspace.cooldown: The hyperdrive is cooling down: %s s
sabercraft.hyperspace.damaged: The hull is too damaged for a jump.
sabercraft.hyperspace.disabled: Hyperspace is turned off on this server.
sabercraft.hyperspace.energy: Not enough energy for a jump.
sabercraft.hyperspace.falling: Not while the ship is going down.
sabercraft.hyperspace.landed: Take off first: hyperspace only in flight.
sabercraft.hyperspace.not_flying: Hyperspace only while flying your own ship.
sabercraft.interior.disabled: Ship interiors are turned off on this server.
sabercraft.interior.escape_pod: The ship is lost! An escape pod brought you down next to the wreck.
sabercraft.interior.caught: A repulsor safety field catches you and sets you back.
sabercraft.interior.helm_offline: The ship does not answer. Leave by the ramp.
sabercraft.interior.in_flight: The ship is being flown. Ask the pilot to land.
sabercraft.interior.slow_down: Slow down first, then you can walk aboard.
sabercraft.interior.lowered: The tractor beam lowers you down.
sabercraft.interior.no_ship: Your ship could not be found. You are back at the spawn.
sabercraft.interior.none: This ship has no rooms to walk around in.
sabercraft.interior.owner_only: Only the owner may come aboard.
sabercraft.interior.too_far: Your ship has to be close by.
sabercraft.option.ship_camera.descriptio: The view when climbing into a starship: from the cockpit (first person), behind the ship, or unchanged. F5 still switches; climbing out brings back your view.
sabercraft.option.music_flight.descripti: Music of its own while flying a starship, and a faster piece in space battles.
sabercraft.ship.menu.aboard.tooltip: Go inside your ship and walk around. If it is not close by, it is called first. Works from the cockpit too. Leave by the ramp or the hangar exit.
sabercraft.ship.not_inside: %s cannot be called inside a ship. Leave the ship first.
sabercraft.seat.cockpit: Sneak to stand up. Hyperspace: the hyperspace key or the lever by the co-pilot.
sabercraft.seat.gunner: Aim with the mouse, attack to fire. Sneak to stand up.
sabercraft.interior.status_none: %s: no contact with the ship's systems.
sabercraft.interior.jump_seat: Sit in the pilot's or co-pilot's seat for the jump.
sabercraft.interior.guns_hot: The guns are overheated. Wait a moment.
sabercraft.collision_debug.on: Collision view on: red = solid, orange = shaped, green = seats and consoles, yellow = doors
sabercraft.crew.line.officer.3: Efficiency is everything aboard this ship.
sabercraft.crew.line.officer.4: I have no time for this.
sabercraft.crew.line.tech.1: Calibrating. Please do not touch the panel.
sabercraft.crew.line.watch.2: Sensors show nothing within range. For now.
sabercraft.crew.line.watch.3: The admiral does not like to be disturbed.
sabercraft.crew.line.bridge.3: Signal the fleet: we hold position.
sabercraft.crew.line.bridge.4: Keep your voice down on the bridge.
sabercraft.crew.line.pit.3: Long shift. Every shift is long.
sabercraft.crew.line.pit.4: Please step back from the console.
sabercraft.crew.line.patrol.4: Stay out of the restricted corridors.
sabercraft.crew.line.patrol.5: Checkpoint ahead. Have your clearance ready.
sabercraft.crew.line.sensor.2: An echo on the scope. Probably debris.
sabercraft.crew.line.conference.3: Loyalty is noted. So is disloyalty.
sabercraft.crew.line.hangar.1: Keep clear of the launch lanes.
sabercraft.crew.line.hangar.2: The landing circle is for arrivals.
sabercraft.crew.line.hangar.3: Flight crews only past this point.
sabercraft.crew.line.hangar.4: Mind the force field. It holds the air in, not you.
sabercraft.crew.line.flight_control.2: Two fighters returning. Clear the racks.
sabercraft.crew.line.flight_control.3: Do not lean on the console.
sabercraft.crew.line.reactor.2: No unauthorised access to the core.
sabercraft.crew.line.reactor.3: Feel that hum? That is a good hum.
sabercraft.crew.line.security.1: Your face is not on my list.
sabercraft.crew.line.security.4: Do not make me check your papers.
sabercraft.crew.line.army.1: The ground forces are ready to deploy.
sabercraft.crew.line.army.3: Navy officers. Always in the way.
sabercraft.crew.line.pilot.1: My fighter is fuelled and ready.
sabercraft.crew.line.pilot.2: No shields, no hyperdrive, no problem.
sabercraft.crew.line.pilot.4: Ever flown one? Didn't think so.
sabercraft.crew.line.guard.3: A cold stare from behind the visor.
sabercraft.crew.line.maintenance.2: Spare parts for the fighters. Don't touch.
sabercraft.crew.line.maintenance.3: Someone always takes the last hydrospanner.
sabercraft.crew.line.smuggler.3: The cargo? Spare parts. Totally legal.
sabercraft.crew.line.smuggler.4: If the alarm goes off, it's probably nothing.
sabercraft.crew.line.smuggler.5: Grab a seat. We might be here a while.
sabercraft.crew.line.smuggler.6: I've got a good feeling about this one.
sabercraft.crew.line.rebel.2: First time on a freighter like this.
sabercraft.crew.line.rebel.3: We'll make it. We always do.
sabercraft.crew.line.rebel.4: Keep your head down if we hit trouble.
sabercraft.crew.remark.star_destroyer.2: Did you hear? The reactor crew got extra rations.
sabercraft.crew.remark.star_destroyer.3: Has anyone seen my helmet? ... Never mind.
sabercraft.crew.remark.star_destroyer.6: The admiral is in a mood today.
sabercraft.crew.remark.star_destroyer.8: Who left a datapad in the lift again?
sabercraft.crew.remark.falcon.1: Hear that? That's the sound of a fast ship.
sabercraft.crew.remark.falcon.2: *a distant growl from the engine room*
sabercraft.crew.remark.falcon.3: If something rattles, hit it. Gently.
sabercraft.crew.remark.falcon.5: Don't sit in the pilot's seat. Seriously.
sabercraft.crew.remark.falcon.6: Smells like coolant in here. That's normal. Probably.
sabercraft.crew.line.spy.2: These vents are the only place without cameras.
sabercraft.crew.line.spy.3: Tell no one about this room. Please.
sabercraft.crew.line.spy.4: The plans? What plans? I'm just resting.
sabercraft.story.d.m1_briefing.start: Two minutes to reversion, Spark. We drop out right under the Tenebris's hangar lip, in its sensor shadow. If Dax flies as well as he claims.
sabercraft.story.d.m1_briefing.situation: For three weeks Kestrel sent us data. Then one last message: "Nightshade is not a ship. It is a hunt." Nothing since. What do you want to know?
How do I get on board?
sabercraft.story.d.m1_briefing.nightshad: We don't know. A project under the reactor, sealed, with its own guard. The troops call the people who go in there "the hunters". That's all Kestrel had.
sabercraft.story.d.m1_briefing.kestrel: A Tenebris technician who changed sides a year ago. She knows every shaft on board. If anyone over there is still alive, it's her.
sabercraft.story.d.m1_briefing.plan: Dax docks at an old maintenance airlock that hasn't been on any plan for years. Behind it is a dark maintenance room with one guard. Kestrel marks her ways with a bird scratched into the metal. Follow the bird.
sabercraft.story.d.m1_briefing.more.plan: What was the way in again?
sabercraft.story.d.m1_briefing.ready: Then give Dax the signal in the cockpit. And Spark: no weapon, no heroics. You are eyes and ears, nothing more. If they catch you, we'll get you out. Somehow.
sabercraft.story.d.m1_dax.start: Ah, our passenger. Reversion in three, two … no, wait. You give the signal. I like it when someone else gets the blame afterwards.
sabercraft.story.d.m1_dax.start.joke: Will the docking clamps even hold?
sabercraft.story.d.m1_dax.joke: Hold? Rorrak welded them himself. Twice. Once of those even on purpose.
sabercraft.story.d.m1_dax.go: Hold on. We drop out, duck under the lip and stick to the hull like a mynock. Not elegant, but it works.
sabercraft.story.d.m1_mira_wait.start: Dax is waiting for your signal in the cockpit. The longer we drift out here, the sooner someone sees us.
sabercraft.story.d.m1_rorrak.start: [A deep, satisfied rumble. Rorrak knocks twice on the docking clamp and gives a thumbs up.]
sabercraft.story.d.m1_rorrak.dax: He says the clamp holds. And that you owe him a caf when you come back. Down the ramp and you're in the airlock.
sabercraft.story.d.m1_m31.start: [Beep! Beep-beep!] A mouse droid is stuck in a tangle of cables, its wheels spinning in the air. "M-31" is stencilled on its side.
sabercraft.story.d.m1_m31.free: [You pull the cable off its axle. M-31 drops onto its wheels, spins once and beeps at you. Very loudly.]
sabercraft.story.d.m1_m31.follow: [Beep.] Quieter now, as if he understood. M-31 follows you. With the droid key (N) he drives to where you look and rattles: whoever hears it goes to check.
sabercraft.story.d.m1_pad.start: MAINTENANCE LOG DECK 9: Cable damage in the maintenance room. Cause: mouse droid M-31, out of control. Memory wipe requested. Until repairs, one guard with a lamp; the lights stay off.
sabercraft.story.d.m1_sign.start: [A bird, scratched into the metal with a blade, its wings spread like a V.] Kestrel's sign. The hatch next to it is only hooked shut. Behind it, a shaft just wide enough to crawl through.
sabercraft.story.d.m1_trooper.start: Night shift on the maintenance deck. Again. What's going to happen down here? A mouse droid eating cables, maybe.
sabercraft.story.d.m2_kestrel.start: Stay where you are. Hands where I can see them.
sabercraft.story.d.m2_kestrel.hello: … So Mira did send someone. Kestrel. Welcome to the nest. It's cramped, it's cold, and it's the only place on board where nobody listens.
sabercraft.story.d.m2_kestrel.hello.out: How do we get out of here?
sabercraft.story.d.m2_kestrel.hello.task: What do you need from me?
sabercraft.story.d.m2_kestrel.nightshade: A hunting machine. It finds kyber crystals across light years, and everything that resonates with them: lightsabers, Jedi … and children who don't know yet what they are.
sabercraft.story.d.m2_kestrel.silence: An ISB officer came aboard and had the relay I was transmitting through monitored. One more message and they would have found me.
sabercraft.story.d.m2_kestrel.out: Through the hangar. Dax can fly through the force field if he knows when. But only once we have what you came for.
sabercraft.story.d.m2_kestrel.task: A contact from the cargo section left me something: a data stick in one of the containers in the hangar. Which one is in the cargo list on the terminal, in my own way. Don't take the corridor, too many people about. The shaft behind the nest comes out by flight control.
sabercraft.story.d.terminal.start: NEST // KESTREL. [The old terminal flickers and hums.] What do you want to see?
sabercraft.story.d.terminal.map: SHIP PLAN: From the nest, shafts lead to the hangar corridor and the detention block. The reactor is amidships, below it a restricted sector without a name. The bridge: guarded too well.
sabercraft.story.d.terminal.diary: DAY 19: They sealed a lab under the reactor. Whoever goes in comes out pale. DAY 21: They call it Nightshade. I think I know now what it is looking for.
sabercraft.story.d.terminal.drop: DEAD DROP: Hangar, the three containers along the back wall. Cargo list: C-3 breathing filters, to Carida Depot. F-9 rations, to Raxus Depot. K-7 spare parts, to Falcon's Eyrie Shipyard. Kestrel's note below: "My bird flies home." Only open it while nobody is looking.
sabercraft.story.d.terminal.hale: INTERCEPTED, ISB CHANNEL 9, HALE TO THE SHADOWBLADE: "Cell two is ready. The spy will come through the main entrance, I'll see to that. After that, the whole network is mine."
sabercraft.story.d.m2_container.start: [Under spare parts, wrapped in oilcloth: a data stick. Someone has scratched a small bird into it.] Got it. Now back to the nest.
sabercraft.story.d.m2_return.start: You have it? Give it here.
sabercraft.story.d.m2_return.read: [She reads. Her face freezes.] It's a target list. Names, planets, ages. Nightshade's first targets.
sabercraft.story.d.m2_return.read.stop: Then we have to stop that thing.
sabercraft.story.d.m2_return.howmany: Twenty-seven. The youngest is six years old.
sabercraft.story.d.m2_return.resolve: Then we take Nightshade's eyes. But for that I need to know what stands behind the lab door. And for that I need you in armour. Rest; we start soon.
sabercraft.story.d.kestrel_idle.start: We have time, but not much. The objective is at the top right. I'll be here.
sabercraft.story.d.m3_kestrel.start: Time you got a new face.
sabercraft.story.d.m3_kestrel.plan: The armory behind the hangar corridor. The security desk in the corridor opens it, but not while anyone is watching. Inside: armour in the lockers, and level two access cards on the quartermaster's desk.
sabercraft.story.d.m3_kestrel.caught: In armour, troopers hardly look. But don't run, don't jump, don't sneak. Officers look closer. And with the ones in black: nod and keep walking.
sabercraft.story.d.m3_kestrel.go: If you can, bring a second set of armour. I'd like to walk down a corridor again instead of crawling.
sabercraft.story.d.m3_console.start: SECURITY DESK DECK 9. Armory: locked. Quartermaster: on duty.
sabercraft.story.d.m3_locker.start: [White plates, cold and heavy. The helmet smells of someone else's sweat.] From the outside I'm one of them now.
sabercraft.story.d.m3_locker2.start: [A second set of armour, a little smaller.] I'll take this one for Kestrel.
sabercraft.story.d.m3_card.start: [A level two access card, still warm from the reader.] This will get me past the checkpoint at the reactor.
sabercraft.story.d.m3_hale.start: [Hale bolts the door behind him.] So nobody disturbs us. Armour that doesn't quite fit. Boots that don't belong to the corps. Easy now, I'm not calling anyone.
sabercraft.story.d.m3_hale.who: Lieutenant Corvan Hale, ISB. I know who you are. Not your name, but what you are.
sabercraft.story.d.m3_hale.who.knows: How do you know about me?
sabercraft.story.d.m3_hale.knows: A mouse droid that suddenly goes missing. A data stick that vanishes from a container. A security desk that opens itself. I'm good at my job.
sabercraft.story.d.m3_hale.want: The same as you: Nightshade must not be finished. I've seen whom they hunt. I can help you, with codes and guard rotations. You only have to trust me.
sabercraft.story.d.m3_hale.want.why: Why would the ISB of all people help us?
sabercraft.story.d.m3_hale.why: Because I prefer to stand on the side that's still standing at the end. Call it foresight. Or conscience, if you like that better.
sabercraft.story.d.m3_hale.trust: A wise choice. Remember this: detention block, code seven-one-four. In case it ever goes wrong, and it will. I'll be in touch.
sabercraft.story.d.m3_hale.refuse: As you wish. But a ship like this forgets nothing. And neither do I.
sabercraft.story.d.quartermaster.start: Carry on, soldier. And don't loiter here, this isn't the mess hall.
sabercraft.story.d.m4_kestrel.start: You're back. Good. Sit down, we need to talk.
sabercraft.story.d.m4_kestrel.trusted: You trusted an ISB officer. I hope you know what you're doing. Hale smiles too much.
sabercraft.story.d.m4_kestrel.refused: Good that you turned Hale down. When the ISB smiles, they have already decided whom to sacrifice.
sabercraft.story.d.m4_kestrel.plan: The lab's plan is in the main console at the reactor. With armour and card you'll get past the checkpoint. Down there a technician works, and an officer walks his rounds. He must not see you copying.
sabercraft.story.d.m4_kestrel.plan.quest: And if the technician asks questions?
sabercraft.story.d.m4_kestrel.questions: Then hopefully with good answers. The night shift has a password. If you don't know it, don't lie too much. Technicians remember lies better than faces.
sabercraft.story.d.m4_kestrel.go: I'll stay on the comlink. If anything goes wrong: out through the shaft.
sabercraft.story.d.m4_checkpoint.start: Halt. The reactor area is restricted. Access card, soldier.
sabercraft.story.d.m4_checkpoint.pass: Level two. All right. Report to the technician at the main console downstairs.
sabercraft.story.d.m4_checkpoint.nope: Then go and get it. Nobody gets through here without a card. Let alone without armour.
sabercraft.story.d.checkpoint_closed.sta: Move along, soldier. You're holding things up.
sabercraft.story.d.m4_tech.start: You're not Harlo. Harlo has the night shift at the main console.
sabercraft.story.d.m4_tech.start.sick: Harlo is sick. I'm covering for him.
sabercraft.story.d.m4_tech.bad: Someone who takes his job seriously. Calm down.
sabercraft.story.d.m4_tech.q2: All right. What's the night shift's password?
sabercraft.story.d.m4_tech.q2.refuse: I don't have to explain myself to you.
sabercraft.story.d.m4_tech.good: Cold light. Finally someone who knows it. Then take over. I'm getting a caf before the reactor burns my eyes out.
sabercraft.story.d.m4_tech.bluff: Changed. I see. I know nothing about that. Do your job; I'll watch.
sabercraft.story.d.m4_tech.hostile: We'll see about that. Security! Intruder at the main console!
sabercraft.story.d.m4_console.start: TENEBRIS // REACTOR MAIN CONSOLE. Access level two … elevated. Copying sector "Lab N". Stay at the console until the copy is done.
sabercraft.story.d.m4_coolant.start: [You close the coolant valve until the needle trembles in the red.] Soon they'll need every hand down here. Fewer guards in the hangar. But the alarm will sound earlier.
sabercraft.story.d.m5_recording.start: Spark, if you're hearing this, they have me. Troopers in the shaft, Hale in front. They took R2 as well. Detention block.
sabercraft.story.d.m5_recording.hatch: My emergency hatch to the detention block is bolted from that side. Mira says you always find a way. Prove it.
sabercraft.story.d.m5_trap.start: Right on time. I was hoping you would come.
sabercraft.story.d.m5_trap.take: Kestrel was only the bait. You are the thread that leads to the others. Take our guest to cell two.
sabercraft.story.d.m5_r2.start: [An indignant trill. R2-V7 hangs in a memory-wipe clamp. You release it and he whistles with relief.] R2-V7 follows you. At locked doors he hacks (droid key N); elsewhere he scans who is nearby.
sabercraft.story.d.m5_kestrel.trusted: Hale, wasn't it? I saw his smile when they took me. Next time you believe me.
sabercraft.story.d.m5_kestrel.refused: You came through the shaft. Hale is surely still waiting for you at the main entrance. Let him wait.
sabercraft.story.d.m5_kestrel.go: Let's get out. The shaft behind the cells leads back to the nest. Narrow and dark. Stay close behind me.
sabercraft.story.d.m5_prisoner.start: Rebels? Here? [She laughs softly.] Tamsin Rhee, scout of Grey Squadron. Six weeks in this cell. Thank you. I'll find my own way out.
sabercraft.story.d.m6_plan.start: There it is: the plan of the lab, right under the reactor. A blast door, one guard, and behind it Nightshade.
sabercraft.story.d.m6_plan.artefact: The tracker needs a crystal to calibrate. A very strong one. The plan has a single name for it: "Artefact Voss".
sabercraft.story.d.m6_plan.pickup: Dax checked in. He'll bring the Falcon to the hangar's force field as soon as we give the signal. The way there won't be quiet.
sabercraft.story.d.m6_plan.escort: I'll wear the second set of armour. I'll go ahead of you down the corridor and keep your back clear.
sabercraft.story.d.m6_plan.fire: I don't have armour, so I'll stay in the shaft and distract them as best I can. The rest is up to you.
sabercraft.story.d.m6_plan.ready: R2 opens the door, M-31 distracts the guard. Ready?
sabercraft.story.d.m6_ilyra.start: Whoever hears this: the crystal has called you. My name is Ilyra Voss. I was a Jedi once.
sabercraft.story.d.m6_ilyra.crystal: They want my blade to find those who come after us. Don't let them. Without the crystal their machine is blind.
sabercraft.story.d.m6_ilyra.ready: Take it. It will not obey you because you command, but because you listen. May the Force be with you.
sabercraft.story.d.m6_saber.start: [The lightsaber floats in the containment field. As you come closer it hums, softly, like an answer.]
sabercraft.story.d.m6_shadow.start: A little spy with a stolen blade. Ilyra Voss fought to the very end. You won't last that long.
sabercraft.story.d.m6_shadow.threat: Give it to me. Or I take it from your hand. Hand and all.
sabercraft.story.d.m6_epilogue.start: We made it. The tracker is dead, the blade is here, and none of us is sitting in a cell. That's more than I expected.
sabercraft.story.d.m6_epilogue.r2: [R2-V7 trills excitedly and projects a flickering display: the tracker's last data, seconds before it failed.]
sabercraft.story.d.m6_epilogue.signature: Wait. That's a signature. A new one. Right before the end, the tracker locked onto someone … Spark. That's you.
sabercraft.story.d.m6_epilogue.knows: That means Nightshade knows you now. And so does the Shadowblade.
sabercraft.story.d.m6_epilogue.dax: Wonderful. A wanted spy, a Jedi blade and a droid with a conscience on board. Sounds like my kind of week.
sabercraft.story.d.m6_epilogue.tamsin: And a rebel who owes you a drink. Get me to the fleet and I'll show you where the Shadowblade comes from.
sabercraft.story.d.m6_epilogue.rorrak: [Rorrak rumbles deeply and rests a heavy paw on your shoulder. Outside, the stars stretch into lines.]
sabercraft.story.d.falcon_crew.start: Everyone aboard? Then hold on. This is going to be bumpy.
sabercraft.story.d.dax_idle.start: I fly, you spy. It's called division of labour.
sabercraft.story.d.rorrak_idle.start: [Rorrak grumbles something and holds out a hydrospanner.]
sabercraft.story.d.rorrak_idle.dax: He says don't touch anything that hums. I say the same about him.

sabercraft.story.journal.eavesdrop: Overheard: the reactor technicians' night password is "Cold light". An ISB officer named Hale is hunting a mole on board.
sabercraft.story.journal.reactor_data: Reactor data: the sealed lab lies right under the reactor, behind a blast door with its own guard.
sabercraft.story.journal.pad_maintenance: Maintenance log deck 9: the mouse droid M-31 was to be wiped for constantly tampering with the wiring. The guard in the dark maintenance room only sees far within the cone of their lamp.
sabercraft.story.journal.terminal_map: Ship plan: from the nest, shafts lead to the hangar corridor and the detention block. Under the reactor lies a restricted sector without a name.
sabercraft.story.journal.terminal_diary: Kestrel's diary: a lab under the reactor was sealed. Whoever goes in comes out pale. They call it Nightshade.
sabercraft.story.journal.terminal_drop: Dead drop: a data stick lies in one of the three containers along the hangar's back wall (C-3 to Carida, F-9 to Raxus, K-7 to Falcon's Eyrie Shipyard). Kestrel: "My bird flies home." Only open it while nobody is looking.
sabercraft.story.journal.terminal_interc: Intercepted: Hale to the Shadowblade. Cell two is a trap for the spy; Hale wants the rebels' whole network.
sabercraft.story.journal.list_children: The data stick holds Nightshade's target list: twenty-seven names. The youngest target is six years old.
sabercraft.story.journal.recording_kestr: Kestrel's recording: she and R2-V7 were taken to the detention block. Hale led the squad.
sabercraft.story.journal.ilyra_message: The message of Ilyra Voss: without her crystal Nightshade is blind. She left her blade to whoever the crystal calls.
sabercraft.story.radio.caught.m1: That was close. Breathe and try again. Quieter this time.
sabercraft.story.radio.caught.m2: They saw you, but didn't recognise you. I made a few lights flicker and got you back. Again, in the shadows.
sabercraft.story.radio.caught.m3: You're no use to me in a cell. I got you out before they opened a file. Once more, calmer.
sabercraft.story.radio.caught.m4: Spark, you're too fast. At the reactor everyone watches everyone. Once more, step by step.
sabercraft.story.radio.caught.m5: Dax here. I was listening in on your channel. Try again, and this time without an audience.
sabercraft.story.radio.caught.m6: Don't give up! The Falcon is waiting, but not forever. Once more!
sabercraft.story.radio.eavesdrop.1: Seen that ISB man? Hale. Two days now he's been standing at the reactor asking questions.
sabercraft.story.radio.eavesdrop.2: Let him ask. The techs down there won't let anyone near the console who doesn't know the night password.
sabercraft.story.radio.eavesdrop.3: "Cold light." I heard it three times when I picked up the coolant readings. Great security.
sabercraft.story.radio.eavesdrop.4: Keep your voice down. Hale is hunting a mole, and he isn't picky about whom he finds.
sabercraft.menu.story.detail_off: The detailed ship interiors are turned off. Without them the story's people and things are invisible.
sabercraft.menu.story.intro: A rebel spy, a Star Destroyer and a word nobody can explain: Nightshade. Six missions: sneak, disguise, rescue. And at the end, a blade that should no longer exist.
sabercraft.menu.story.leave.description: You return to where you were and get your things and droids back. Your progress stays saved.
sabercraft.menu.story.loading: Asking the server for your progress …
sabercraft.menu.story.no_server: This server does not have SaberCraft, or an older version. The story needs the mod on the server.
sabercraft.menu.story.play.description: Plays the chosen mission from its beginning. What you have already reached stays unlocked.
sabercraft.menu.story.start.description: Starts the story or continues where you left off. Your things, your place and your droids are kept safe and given back when you leave.
sabercraft.menu.story.things: During the story the mod keeps your items and droids safe. When you leave you get everything back.
sabercraft.menu.story.title: Story: Nightshade
sabercraft.story.droid.m31_distract: M-31 darts off and beeps loudly. Someone goes to check.
sabercraft.story.droid.m31_field: M-31 tinkers with the field generator. The force field dies.
sabercraft.story.droid.m31_hatch: M-31 slips through the grate and unbolts the hatch from the other side.
sabercraft.story.droid.m31_noise: M-31 beeps into the dark. Nobody nearby heard it.
sabercraft.story.droid.r2_busy: R2-V7 is already working on a lock.
sabercraft.story.droid.r2_hack: R2-V7 plugs in and starts hacking. It beeps; anyone nearby will hear it.
sabercraft.story.droid.r2_scan: R2-V7 scans the area: anyone nearby is shown for a few seconds.
sabercraft.story.end: Nightshade is blind, for now. But the tracker caught your signature, and the Shadowblade lives. Chapter 2 will follow. In the story menu (%s) you can play any mission again. When you leave the story you get your things back, and Ilyra's lightsaber with them.
sabercraft.story.hint.calm: They call off the search but stay wary: more guards in the corridors.
sabercraft.story.hint.cell_open: The force field dies. The cell is open.
sabercraft.story.hint.detected: Detected! Break line of sight and hide.
sabercraft.story.hint.detected_officer: The officer has seen you. He draws his pistol and calls for troopers.
sabercraft.story.hint.qm_leaving: The quartermaster is about to come out. Stay out of his sight.
sabercraft.story.hint.disguise: Disguised. Walk calmly: no running, no jumping, no sneaking. Officers still look more closely.
sabercraft.story.hint.download_paused: The copy is paused. Stay at the console.
sabercraft.story.hint.eavesdrop: Overheard: the night password and a name. Hale.
sabercraft.story.hint.hatch_free: M-31 slips through the grate. A click: the hatch is open.
sabercraft.story.hint.hatch_locked: Locked. You won't get through here like this.
sabercraft.story.hint.locked_hack: Locked. R2-V7 can open it: press the droid key (N) nearby.
sabercraft.story.hint.no_way: There is no way out here.
sabercraft.story.hint.searching: They are searching for you. Stay out of sight.
sabercraft.story.hint.seen: Seen. That had to be done unseen. Once more from the start.
sabercraft.story.hint.stay_falcon: Not now. The ramp stays shut.
sabercraft.story.hint.terminal: Kestrel's terminal in the hideout is still running. Maybe it picked something up.
sabercraft.story.hint.bridge_creak: The bridge groans under the fire! Get across, fast!
sabercraft.story.hint.trapped: A trap. Cell two, the force field hums. But outside, something small beeps …
sabercraft.story.hud.use_hack: %2$s: locked (R2-V7 can hack it, droid key)
sabercraft.story.locked: Not available during a story mission. Leave the story from the story menu (%s).
sabercraft.story.no_interiors: The story mode needs the ship interiors, but this world has none.
sabercraft.story.radio.dax_arrives: Dax here! The Falcon is at the force field, ramp down. Run!
sabercraft.story.radio.hale_offer: Hale here. The detention block is open for you; I pulled the guard. Cell two. Come alone.
sabercraft.story.radio.m4_cut: I have the data, Spark! The lab is right under … [static] … troopers at the nest, they … [The connection drops.]
sabercraft.story.radio.m4_officer: Careful, the officer is coming down! Away from the console until he leaves. The copy will wait.
sabercraft.story.radio.m4_watch: He won't take his eyes off you. Have M-31 make a noise somewhere and he'll look away. And if he grows too suspicious, step away from the console for a moment. The copy will wait.
sabercraft.story.radio.saber_taken: The tracker is down, and the field was tied to the reactor core! Hear that? It's going critical. To the lift, then to the hangar. And trust the thing in your hand.
sabercraft.story.radio.shadow_retreat: This is not the end, spy. Nightshade does not forget.
sabercraft.story.radio.vorr_alert: All decks: intruder in the reactor section. Seal every access, the ISB takes over. The emergency lights stay on: in the dark everyone is equally blind. I want this spy alive.
sabercraft.story.radio.bridge_down: The bridge is gone, they can't reach you any more! To the lift, quick!
sabercraft.story.stash_failed: Your things could not be stored safely, so the story does not start.

sabercraft.option.story_marker.descripti: Shows the direction and distance to the current objective and, when someone notices you, an arc pointing at them. Off: you rely on your eyes alone.

sabercraft.menu.story.mission.descriptio: Choose a mission you have already reached to play it again.
sabercraft.outfit.stormtrooper.descripti: White plate armour with helmet. Only in the story, as a disguise.
sabercraft.story.obj.m1.distract: Have M-31 lure the guard away from the hatch (N: he drives to where you look and rattles)
sabercraft.story.radio.m1_distract: Spark, the guard is standing right in front of the hatch. Look at a spot a few metres beside him and press the droid key: M-31 drives there and rattles. Whoever hears it goes to look. But not too often, or nobody will believe him any more.
sabercraft.story.radio.m1_go: He's going to check. Now, to the hatch!
sabercraft.story.hint.droid_distract: Tip: look at a spot on the floor a few metres beside the guard and press the droid key (N). M-31 drives there and rattles; whoever hears it goes to look.
sabercraft.story.hint.hatch_guarded: The guard is standing right in front of it. Lure him away first.
sabercraft.story.hint.cell_droid: Outside by the bench M-31 waits, beeping quietly to himself.
sabercraft.story.droid.m31_distract_one: M-31 beeps where you are looking. %s goes to check.
sabercraft.story.droid.m31_distract_more: M-31 beeps where you are looking. %s of them go to check.
sabercraft.story.d.m2_crate_c3.start: [The lid clatters. Inside: breathing filters, neatly stacked, nothing else.] Wrong container. And loud, too.
sabercraft.story.d.m2_crate_f9.start: [Ration packs, box after box. The lid falls back with a bang.] Not here. The cargo list says more than you'd think.
sabercraft.story.d.m3_console.start.page: Page the quartermaster to the hangar
sabercraft.story.d.m3_console.unlocked: [A few commands, a click somewhere in the wall. The light on the desk jumps from red to green.] The armory is open.
sabercraft.story.d.m3_console.unlocked.p: Page the quartermaster to the hangar
sabercraft.story.d.m3_console.paged: [An announcement echoes down the corridor.] An excuse is quickly typed: a delivery in the hangar, signature needed. The quartermaster will grumble, but he'll go.
sabercraft.story.radio.page_quartermaste: Quartermaster to the hangar, please. Delivery awaiting signature.
sabercraft.story.shout.officer_halt: You there! Hands where I can see them!
sabercraft.story.shout.officer_call: Officer to all units: intruder in my section! Send troopers!
sabercraft.story.shout.alarm_call: Alert on this deck! Intruder reported, a security team is on its way.
sabercraft.story.shout.emergency: Safety shutdown in the reactor ring. Main lights off, emergency lighting active.
sabercraft.story.shout.lights_on: Main lights restored. All troops to the reactor!
sabercraft.story.shout.bridge_gone: The bridge is gone! We can't get across!
sabercraft.story.hint.detected_call: Spotted! Someone is running for a wall comm to raise the alarm. Get out of here!
sabercraft.story.hint.reinforcements: Two stormtroopers are on their way. Hide!
sabercraft.story.d.m4_officer.start: You there, trooper! Yes, you. The reactor floor is no place to stand around. What's your business down here?
sabercraft.story.d.m4_officer.start.hale: Lieutenant Hale of the ISB sent me.
sabercraft.story.d.m4_officer.start.patr: Routine inspection, sir. Orders from above.
sabercraft.story.d.m4_officer.who: Level two. Fine. And who requested you?
sabercraft.story.d.m4_officer.who.harlo: Technician Harlo, sir. For the night shift at the main console.
sabercraft.story.d.m4_officer.fine: Very well. Do your job, and don't stand in my way.
sabercraft.story.d.m4_officer.isb: The ISB. Of course. Then do what you came for, but not near me.
sabercraft.story.d.m4_officer.bad: Routine. At this hour. Without reporting to me. Stay where you are!
sabercraft.story.journal.droid_m31: Your droids: M-31, mouse droid. Droid key (N): he drives to the spot on the floor you look at (up to 12 blocks, not through walls) and rattles about there. Only those who hear it react: the nearest goes to look, others glance over. By the third time nobody believes him, and afterwards he needs a 20-second rest. He slips through grates and is handy with machines. With the second droid key he waits or follows you.
sabercraft.story.journal.droid_r2v7: Your droids: R2-V7, astromech. Droid key (N) close to a lock: he hacks it (it beeps; anyone near looks). Otherwise he scans who is about.
sabercraft.story.hud.droid_tip: [%s] M-31: a noise where you look
sabercraft.story.film.arrival.title: TENEBRIS
sabercraft.story.film.arrival.subtitle: Imperial Star Destroyer
sabercraft.story.film.arrival.dax1: There she is. The Tenebris. A mile of bad temper.
sabercraft.story.film.arrival.mira: We're in their sensor shadow. Under the edge, Dax, the airlock's right there.
sabercraft.story.film.arrival.dax2: I see it. Rorrak, clamps out!
sabercraft.story.film.arrival.dax3: Docked. Like a mynock. Told you.
key.sabercraft.story_focus: Story: Focus (slowed time in a fight)
sabercraft.story.droid.m31_go: M-31 zips off. He makes a racket as soon as he gets there.
sabercraft.story.droid.m31_busy: M-31 is already on his way.
sabercraft.story.droid.m31_recharge: M-31 is still worn out (%s s).
sabercraft.story.droid.m31_where: Look at a spot on the floor a few metres away (12 at most).
sabercraft.story.hint.m31_noway: M-31 cannot get through and turns back.
sabercraft.story.hint.m31_lure_one: A guard heard it and goes to look.
sabercraft.story.hint.m31_lure_look: They only glance over. Use the same trick too often and nobody falls for it.
sabercraft.story.hint.m31_lure_ignored: They know that racket by now and ignore it.
sabercraft.story.hint.m31_lure_none: Nobody was close enough to hear it.
sabercraft.story.shout.mouse_again: That mouse droid again. Let it rattle.
sabercraft.story.shout.search: Intruder on deck. All squads: search the last known position!
sabercraft.story.shout.search_over: Search called off. Extra patrols stay in the corridors. Keep your eyes open.
sabercraft.story.hint.stunned: Stun hit! Three and they have you.
sabercraft.story.hint.force_locked: Here the Force only serves to guard and dash. Ilyra's blade will teach you more.
sabercraft.story.hint.focus_learned: Ilyra's blade remembers: Focus (G) briefly slows time in a fight when the meter is full.
sabercraft.story.hint.focus_unknown: You do not know the Focus yet.
sabercraft.story.hint.focus_calm: The Focus only works in a fight.
sabercraft.story.hint.focus_empty: The Focus is not ready yet. Block blows to fill it.
sabercraft.story.radio.focus: Spark! Whatever clings to that blade, I can feel it from here. Let it guide you.
sabercraft.story.journal.focus: Focus (G): Ilyra's blade brought a skill. In a fight its meter fills (faster when you block blows); when full it slows your enemies for four seconds. Other Force powers do not work in the story; guard and dash do.
sabercraft.story.shout.shadow_phase2: Not bad, spy. But that was only the beginning.
sabercraft.story.shout.shadow_lock: You are stronger than I thought...
sabercraft.story.shout.shadow_defeat: No... This is not over, spy.
sabercraft.story.film.duel.title: The Shadowblade
sabercraft.story.film.duel.subtitle: Hangar of the Tenebris
sabercraft.story.d.after_dax.start: Course for the fleet is laid in, the autopilot's holding. First time in days nobody's chasing us. Feels almost suspicious.
sabercraft.story.d.after_dax.hale_truste: So, Spark. Next time an ISB officer promises you a safe way, ask the smuggler first. We know a thing or two about lies.
sabercraft.story.d.after_dax.hale_refuse: Good thing you didn't trust Hale. I wasn't in the mood to scrape you out of another cell.
sabercraft.story.d.after_dax.ship: They're turning over every freighter in the sector now. But they never saw the Falcon, only a shadow under their own hangar edge. Rorrak already swapped the transponder code.
sabercraft.story.d.after_dax.next: We drop you, Kestrel and Ilyra's blade off with the fleet. I get paid, and then … well. After what R2-V7 recorded, you'll need a pilot again soon. Just saying: I'm expensive.
sabercraft.story.d.after_kestrel.start: Three years aboard the Tenebris, and now I'm sitting in the co-pilot's seat of a freighter that has no business flying. Thank you, Spark. Really.
sabercraft.story.d.after_kestrel.armour: And thanks for the second armour. Never thought I'd be glad to be stuck in white plastic.
sabercraft.story.d.after_kestrel.plain: I pictured getting out of there so many times. I imagined less fire.
sabercraft.story.d.after_kestrel.tracker: Dead, for now. But the last data R2-V7 saved carries your signature. Nightshade knows what to look for now. We have to be faster.
sabercraft.story.d.after_kestrel.shadow: Fled, not beaten. Before he vanished through that door, he turned to look at you one more time. He'll be back, Spark. And not alone.
sabercraft.story.d.after_mira.start: I've sent word to the fleet. They're expecting us: you, Kestrel and Ilyra's blade. There'll be questions none of us can answer.
sabercraft.story.d.after_mira.tamsin: And Tamsin Rhee. They had given up on her. You got more than one person out of that ship today.
sabercraft.story.d.after_mira.alone: When I think of the other cells … we couldn't take everyone. Maybe next time.
sabercraft.story.d.after_mira.saber: Take good care of that blade. Ilyra Voss didn't hide it without reason. And the Shadowblade knows who carries it now.
sabercraft.story.d.after_rorrak.start: [Rorrak rumbles contentedly and pats the hyperdrive's housing. It held, in spite of everything.]
sabercraft.story.d.after_rorrak.dax: He says the drive held because he talked it through. I say we got lucky. He says that's the same thing.
sabercraft.story.d.after_tamsin.start: Months in that cell. I thought I'd never again see stars that didn't flicker behind a force field.
sabercraft.story.d.after_tamsin.promise: When we reach the fleet, I'll tell you everything I know about the Shadowblade. He came to the detention block often. He was looking for someone. I think he's found them now.
sabercraft.story.obj.chapter_done: Chapter 1 complete. The Falcon is on its way to the fleet.
sabercraft.story.hud.chapter_done_hint: Story menu (%s): play any mission again
sabercraft.story.droid.r2_aim: R2-V7 beeps a question: look at the lock you want opened.
sabercraft.story.hint.hunted: You can't do that right now. You've been spotted! Shake off your pursuers first.
sabercraft.story.hint.saber_kept: The lightsaber stays with you. You'll still need it.
sabercraft.story.droid.waiting: %s waits where you left it. Call it back to you with its key.
sabercraft.story.shout.reactor_critical: Warning: reactor core unstable! Containment failing. All technicians to the reactor!
sabercraft.story.shout.evacuate: All decks: reactor critical! Evacuate now! To the escape pods!
sabercraft.story.hint.takedown_near: Closer, right behind him, then you can overpower him.
sabercraft.story.hint.takedown_seen: He saw you coming! Only from behind, while he looks away.
sabercraft.story.hint.takedown_done: The guard is out. Quietly now.
sabercraft.story.film.escape.title: THE END OF THE TENEBRIS
sabercraft.story.film.escape.subtitle: Chapter 1: Nightshade
sabercraft.story.film.escape.dax1: Hold on! We're out, and she's about to blow!
sabercraft.story.film.escape.kestrel: The reactor is going. The whole ship! Dax, more thrust!
sabercraft.story.film.duel_end.dax: Spark, do you hear me? We're coming for you. Get to the Falcon!
sabercraft.title.splash.20: The Falcon is ready to launch!
sabercraft.title.splash.22: May the Force ... well, you know!
sabercraft.title.splash.23: Stars as far as the eye can see.
sabercraft.title.subtitle: SABERCRAFT
sabercraft.story.radio.m5_service: They've seen you! Not the lift. From the east platform a maintenance walkway runs north, follow the yellow lamps. At its end there's a maintenance door, the emergency release is to its left. Behind it a shaft leads to me. Bolt the door behind you!
sabercraft.story.radio.m5_service_out: You made it. Now they're hammering on a bolted door. Stay down here until the alarm dies down.
sabercraft.story.hint.service_way: To the maintenance shaft: along the walkway with the yellow lamps, the emergency release is left of the door.
sabercraft.story.hint.service_release_pa: The release has stopped. Stay at the console.
sabercraft.story.hint.service_open: The maintenance door is open. Inside you can bolt it.
sabercraft.story.hint.service_blocked: Someone is standing in the doorway.
sabercraft.story.hint.service_bolted: Door bolted. On into the shaft!
sabercraft.story.hint.service_shut: The door slams shut behind you and bolts.
sabercraft.story.film.hale_in.hale1: Not so fast. Stay where you are.
sabercraft.story.film.service.trooper3: Control, lost the target in maintenance. Search the whole level!
sabercraft.story.film.saber.intercom: Warning: power surge in the lab. Containment field down. Reactor core unstable.
sabercraft.story.hint.lift_locked: The lift to the bridge is locked. The bridge has been sealed off.

sabercraft.story.difficulty.easy.descrip: Fewer guards, shorter sight; they notice you more slowly and shoot less often. Four hits before they catch you. A weaker boss.
sabercraft.story.difficulty.normal.descr: The story as it is meant to be: watchful enemies, fair chances. Three hits before they catch you.
sabercraft.story.difficulty.hard.descrip: More guards, longer sight, faster enemies, longer searches, truer shots. Two hits before they catch you. A stronger boss.

sabercraft.story.hint.stunned_easy: Stun hit! Four, and they have you.
sabercraft.story.hint.stunned_hard: Stun hit! Two, and they have you.
sabercraft.hint.title: SaberCraft
sabercraft.hint.menu_key_moved: Open the SaberCraft menu: %s (was V, now free, e.g. for Simple Voice Chat). Change it in Options > Controls > Key Binds.
sabercraft.hint.vent: Maintenance shaft: hatches with a yellow and black frame and a small lamp can be used. %s on the hatch opens it, then just walk in. (Or hold %s.)
sabercraft.hint.vent_inside: In the shaft: %s crawls forward. %s on the open hatch behind you shuts it.
sabercraft.hint.vent_short: %s on the hatch: open it and crawl in
sabercraft.story.hint.bridge_sealed: Security barrier: the turbolift to the bridge is sealed off. Nothing for you up there.
sabercraft.story.radio.m2_side_hatch: Good, you have it. If flight control gets too crowded, take the maintenance hatch low in the hangar's west wall, right beside the crate stack.
